sum: Haoxin Holdings Limited, through its subsidiaries, provides temperature-controlled truckload service and urban delivery services in the People's Republic of China. The company engages in factory logistics, including electronic devices, chemicals, fruit, food, and commercial goods. It operates a truckload fleet with 70 tractors, 97 trailers, and 31 vans. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Ningbo, China. Haoxin Holdings Limited operates as a subsidiary of TZJ Global (BVI) Limited.
ceo: Mr. Zhengjun  Tao (CEO & Chairman of the Board)
